cohort: The study included 100 term neonates with hyperbilirubinemia receiving phototherapy in a tertiary healthcare institute in North India.
finding: Serum magnesium levels significantly decreased in term neonates after 24 hours of double surface phototherapy, irrespective of gender and birth weight group.
followup_time: Approximately 81 hours after birth (mean neonatal age at phototherapy initiation + 24 hours of phototherapy).
